<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: linear-gradient(-45deg, #ffffff, #e0f7ff, #ffffff, #d9f0ff);
  background-size: 400% 400%;
  animation: gradientBG 15s ease infinite;
  color: #222;
}
@keyframes gradientBG {
  0% {background-position: 0% 50%;}
  50% {background-position: 100% 50%;}
  100% {background-position: 0% 50%;}
}

.instruction-bar {
  max-width: 1000px;
  margin: 25px auto 10px auto;
  padding: 12px 25px;
  background: #ffffffcc;
  border-left: 6px solid #0288d1;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  font-size: 15px;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.instruction-bar strong {
  color: #006494;
}

.leaflet-container {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 1100px;
  height: 630px !important;
  margin: 20px auto 40px auto;
  display: block;
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  filter: saturate(1.05) contrast(1.02);
}

/* Popup wrapper and content */
.leaflet-popup-content-wrapper {
  background: transparent !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  max-width: 620px;
  text-align: center;
}
.leaflet-popup-content {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  text-align: center;
}

/* Popup image */
.popup-img {
  max-height: 280px;
  width: auto;
  max-width: 100%;
  display: block;
  margin: 4px auto 2px auto;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  cursor: zoom-in;
  transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}
.popup-img:hover {
  transform: scale(1.03);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

/* Mini map */
.leaflet-control-minimap {
  bottom: 20px !important;
  right: 20px !important;
  height: 120px !important;
  width: 180px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Fullscreen map */
.leaflet-container:fullscreen,
.leaflet-container:-webkit-full-screen,
.leaflet-container:-moz-full-screen,
.leaflet-container:-ms-fullscreen {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
}

/* Close button - above the popup box */
.leaflet-popup-close-button {
  color: black !important;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: bold;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  text-shadow: none !important;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  line-height: 24px;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  cursor: pointer;
  filter: none !important;

  position: relative !important;
  top: -10px !important;
  right: -265px !important;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  z-index: 1000;
}

/* Fullscreen overlay */
#img-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
  display: none;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  z-index: 9999;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 10px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
#img-overlay img {
  max-width: 90%;
  max-height: 90%;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
  cursor: zoom-out;
}
#close-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 30px;
  font-size: 32px;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: black;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-shadow: none;
  user-select: none;
  z-index: 10000;
}
</style>

## 🌎 My Travel Map

<!-- Fullscreen image overlay -->
<div id="img-overlay" aria-modal="true" role="dialog" aria-label="Fullscreen image view">
  <button id="close-overlay" aria-label="Close fullscreen image">&times;</button>
</div>

<!-- Instruction bar -->
<div class="instruction-bar">
  🖱️ <strong>Hover</strong> on markers to preview imag
  <strong>Zoom in</strong> to to see multiple images. <br>
  Note: The map is for visual exploration only and does not necessarily represent political boundaries.
</div>

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE}
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)

data <- read.csv("places.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Popup with title and year above image
data$popup <- paste0(
  "<div style='width:600px; margin:0; padding:0;'>",
  "<div style='font-size:15px; margin:4px 0 2px 0; font-weight:bold; color:#0077b6;'>",
  data$desc, " <span style='color:#444;'>(", data$yr, ")</span></div>",
  "<img src='Images/places/", data$filename, "' class='popup-img' ",
  "onclick=\"showFull('Images/places/", data$filename, "')\" alt='", data$desc, "'>",
  "</div>"
)

leaflet(data) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Voyager) %>%
  setView(lng = 0, lat = 10, zoom = 1.5) %>%
  addMarkers(
    lng = ~lng,
    lat = ~lat,
    label = ~desc,
    popup = ~popup,
    options = markerOptions(riseOnHover = TRUE, autoClose = FALSE, closeOnClick = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  addMiniMap(toggleDisplay = TRUE, minimized = FALSE) %>%
  addFullscreenControl(position = "topright", pseudoFullscreen = FALSE) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;
      var clickedMarkers = new Set();
      map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
        if(layer instanceof L.Marker) {
          layer.on('mouseover', function(e) {
            this.openPopup();
          });
          layer.on('mouseout', function(e) {
            if(!clickedMarkers.has(this._leaflet_id)) {
              this.closePopup();
            }
          });
          layer.on('click', function(e) {
            if(clickedMarkers.has(this._leaflet_id)) {
              this.closePopup();
              clickedMarkers.delete(this._leaflet_id);
            } else {
              clickedMarkers.add(this._leaflet_id);
              this.openPopup();
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }
  ")
